facts: A novel method is presented for discovering parallel sentences in comparable, non-parallel corpora.
A maximum entropy classifier is trained.
The maximum entropy classifier is given a pair of sentences.
The maximum entropy classifier can reliably determine whether the sentences are translations of each other.
Parallel data is extracted from non-parallel newspaper corpora.
Parallel data is extracted from large Chinese non-parallel newspaper corpora.
Parallel data is extracted from large Arabic non-parallel newspaper corpora.
Parallel data is extracted from large English non-parallel newspaper corpora.
The quality of the extracted data is evaluated by showing improved performance of a state-of-the-art statistical machine translation system.
The extracted data improves the performance of a state-of-the-art statistical machine translation system.
A good-quality MT system can be built from scratch.
The good-quality MT system is built by starting with a very small parallel corpus of 100,000 words.
The good-quality MT system is built by exploiting a large non-parallel corpus.
The Chinese, Arabic, and English non-parallel newspaper corpora are large.
The method can be applied with great benefit to language pairs for which only scarce resources are available.
entities: Chinese , Arabic , and English non-parallel newspaper corpora
